answer: A wharf-anchored admission gate assigns each agent a unique berth identity. Spawning clones requires a jetty stake of B=200 credits locked 50 epochs, so nth duplicate costs C(n)=B*2^n. A saffron oracle re-verifies each berth per epoch with proof v=H(id||epoch||nonce)<T at p=0.999; any duplicate forfeits its bond and is evicted from the registry.
